name: AnimeIowa
blurb: Iowa's first anime convention (est. 1997), held each summer at the Hyatt Regency Coralville with voice actor guests, cosplay and DJs.

editions.venue: Hyatt Regency Coralville Hotel & Conference Center
editions.evidence: JSON-LD Event on the homepage/guests page: 'Convention Time – Anime Iowa: Anime Valley' 2027-07-30 to 2027-08-01 @ Hyatt Regency Coralville; page text: '2027 July 30th – August 1st'; the Hotel & Rooms page gives the full venue address: 'Hyatt Regency Coralville Hotel & Conference Center 300 E 9th Street Coralville, IA., 52241'.

notes: The seed location (Des Moines, IA) is wrong: the con's own Hotel & Rooms page gives its address as 300 E 9th Street, Coralville, IA 52241 (Hyatt Regency Coralville), so city/region were corrected to Coralville, IA. No organizer company/nonprofit name was found on the pages sampled. Verify pass (2026-10-05): current -- the guests page itself carries JSON-LD Event data for 'Convention Time – Anime Iowa: Anime Valley' 2027-07-30 to 2027-08-01 plus calendar entries like 'Set up For Anime Iowa 2027!', with no stale-year, 'coming soon' or cancellation wording found, so the lineup stands. REFUTED (refute-04, 2026-10-05): that JSON-LD/calendar widget is a sitewide 'Upcoming Events' block that appears identically on every page (including each individual guest's own bio subpage), so it is template-level, not per-guest, proof. The guest cards themselves carry no 2027 tie; worse, Steve Bennett's own bio text reads 'Celebrating our 30th anniversary, please give a warm welcome home to Steve Bennett!' -- and a web search confirms AnimeIowa's 30th-anniversary edition ('Anime Iowa: Isaki') already ran July 31-August 2, 2026 at this same Hyatt Regency Coralville, ending 2 months ago, with this exact roster (Brian Beacock, Carrie Savage, Chris Tergliafera, Patrick Pedraza, Steve Bennett, Samurai Dan, The Kamikaze Snowmen). So every picked guest belongs to the 30th-anniversary (2026) show, not the 2027 'Anime Valley' edition being tracked here.
